Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Cobalt Peripheral Stent is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5 Tesla only
• a maximum spatial field gradient of 19-T/m
• Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 2-W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
• Maximum Head SAR 0.1 W/kg
• No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session
• head transmit/receive coil only
• Receive with the head transmit/receive coil
• Scan regions: Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone)
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Cobalt Peripheral Stent is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
